item.title: Empire of the Fund
item.description: Much of what Empire of the Fund relates is, or should be, familiar to the practitioner. item.description: To learn how to make index investing work for you, there’s no better mentor than legendary mutual fund industry veteran John C. Bogle. item.title: The Clash of the Cultures
item.description: Over the course of his sixty-year career in the mutual fund industry, Vanguard Group founder John C. Bogle has witnessed a massive shift in the culture of the financial sector.
